sources.entry: Friendica - Social Communication Server. (Source Code) AGPL-3.0 PHP

summary.one_liner: Friendica is a free, open-source, decentralised social networking server that federates with other Fediverse platforms.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes Friendica as a platform for decentralised social communication that links to other independent social and corporate services. It connects users to a federated network of servers called the Fediverse and says users can interact with accounts on Friendica, Mastodon, Lemmy, Diaspora, Misskey, PeerTube, Pixelfed, Pleroma and others. It can also receive content from Tumblr, WordPress and RSS. Content can be imported and mirrored through add-ons such as IFTTT and Buffer, and users can control the privacy scope of their posts. The README is brief and does not detail installation or specific features beyond these points.
use_cases: federated social media with Mastodon users
follow RSS feeds and WordPress or Tumblr blogs in one place
cross-post content through IFTTT or Buffer
run a personal or community social server
how_to_run: Join a public Friendica instance, or set up your own Friendica instance (README links to setup; no commands given in README)
notable: Federates with Mastodon, Lemmy, Diaspora, Misskey, PeerTube, Pixelfed, Pleroma and other Fediverse platforms
Can ingest content from Tumblr, WordPress and RSS
Import and mirror content via add-ons such as IFTTT and Buffer
caveats: README gives no installation commands or system requirements
Setup details are not included in the README
